positive_tests.title: Save payment card successfully
positive_tests.description: Verify that a registered shopper can save a valid payment card and it is stored securely.
positive_tests.expected_result: Payment card is saved successfully with status 201

positive_tests.title: View saved payment cards
positive_tests.description: Verify that a shopper can view all previously saved payment cards.
positive_tests.expected_result: List of payment cards is returned with status 200

positive_tests.title: Delete payment card successfully
positive_tests.description: Verify that a shopper can delete a previously saved payment card.
positive_tests.expected_result: Payment card is deleted successfully with status 204

negative_tests.title: Reject invalid payment card data
negative_tests.description: Verify that invalid payment card data is rejected and appropriate validation errors are returned.
negative_tests.expected_result: Validation error is returned for invalid card data with status 400

negative_tests.title: Reject expired payment card
negative_tests.description: Verify that an expired payment card is rejected during save.

negative_tests.title: Prevent unauthorized card access
negative_tests.description: Verify that a shopper cannot access payment cards belonging to another user.

negative_tests.title: Reject delete for non-existent card
negative_tests.description: Verify that deleting a non-existent payment card returns appropriate error.

boundary_tests.title: Verify payment card expiration boundary
boundary_tests.boundary_condition: Card expires after exactly 3 years from issue date.
boundary_tests.expected_result: A card at the documented expiration boundary is handled according to VAL-002.

boundary_tests.title: Maximum card number length boundary
boundary_tests.expected_result: A 19-digit card number is accepted when all other validation rules pass.

validation_tests.title: Validate required request fields
validation_tests.validation_target: Request payload requires cardNumber, expiryDate, and cvv.
validation_tests.expected_result: Each omitted required field produces its documented validation error.

contract_tests.title: Save payment card contract test
contract_tests.expected_result: Responses conform to the documented API-001 status codes and schema.

contract_tests.title: List payment cards contract test
contract_tests.expected_result: Responses conform to the documented API-002 status codes and schema.

gaps_report.notes: All requirements and validation rules have complete test coverage. API contracts are fully tested.
